name: Roll the ball

description:
Can you collect all the cubes before time is up? Roll the ball is a game based on the Unity "Roll-a-Ball" project that you can find it in learn.unity.com.
If you want to, you can download Roll the Ball for Windows with better resolution, see the process from how I created Roll the Ball and what problems had each version. All this, you will find it in: 
https://pandanti.itch.io/roll-the-ball
See you there ;).
Pandanti
